parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is optional when you authenticate by using an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or temporary STS credentials.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The end time for filtering commits.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can get this ID from your Alibaba Cloud DevOps organization URL, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. The default value is `1`.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of results to return on each page. The default value is `20`. The value must be an integer from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path of a file in the repository. If you specify this parameter, the operation returns only the commits that affect this path. If you do not specify this parameter, the operation returns the commits of the entire repository.

parameters.name: refName
parameters.description: The branch name, tag name, or commit ID. If this parameter is not specified, the system uses the default branch of the repository.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: The keyword to use for the search in commits.

parameters.name: showCommentsCount
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include the number of comments in the response. The default value is `false`.

parameters.name: showSignature
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include the signature in the response. The default value is `false`.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start time for filtering commits.
